title: arabis albida var. brevifolia
intro: Arabis albida var. brevifolia, commonly known as Snow Gentian, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help reduce pain and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Snow Gentian include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Arabis albida var. brevifolia include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
